# m3eui, m3eui/tokens & m3eui v1.0 (Material 3 Expressive 1.5 for Web React)

> Production-ready Material 3 Expressive (`1.5.0`) React component system built on `@base-ui/react` (`1.9.0`), `motion` (`12.x`), pure TypeScript HCT & spring math (`m3eui/tokens`), declarative `m3e.json` project configuration (`m3eui`), 100% key-based i18n with auto-RTL, and semantic CSS custom properties (`light-dark()`, zero Tailwind).

## Packages & Subpath Entrypoints
- `m3eui`: `"use client"`-ready React components (60+ exports), `<M3EProvider config={m3eConfig}>`, `CSPProvider`, `getM3EInitScript()`, and spring hooks.
- `m3eui/styles.css`: Complete semantic stylesheet (`--m3e-color-*` via `light-dark()`, logical RTL properties, `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`, `@media (forced-colors: active)`).
- `m3eui/i18n`: Key-based i18n dictionary types (`M3EMessages`, 71 keys), built-in locale packs (`zh-CN`, `en-US`, `ja-JP`, `ar-SA`), `createM3ETranslator`, `isRtlLocale`, and UTC-anchored `Intl` date/time helpers.
- `m3eui/config`: `defineM3EConfig`, `resolveM3EConfig`, `serializeM3EConfig`, `generateM3EStaticThemeCss`.
- `m3eui/primitives`: Re-exported compound `@base-ui/react` namespaces (`DialogPrimitives`, `SelectPrimitives`, `NavigationMenuPrimitives`, `CollapsiblePrimitives`, `CSPProvider`, etc.).
- `m3eui` (`m3e` binary): `m3e init`, `m3e sync` (compiles `m3e.json` to static `:root` CSS), `m3e locale`, and `m3e doctor` (audits config + zero hardcoded CJK strings) + `m3e.schema.json`.
- `m3eui/tokens` & `m3eui/tokens.json`: Platform-agnostic HCT color generator (`contrastLevel` `[-1, 1]`), dual-track spring solver (Web/CSS `linear()`/SwiftUI/Flutter/Compose), zero-sum width & corner topology solvers, 35 normalized `[0..1]` `MaterialShapes`, and wavy SVG path builders.

## Declarative Setup (`m3e.json` + React / Next.js App Router)
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://unpkg.com/m3eui@1.1.0/m3e.schema.json",
  "style": "expressive",
  "theme": {
    "seed": "#6750A4",
    "schemeVariant": "expressive",
    "colorMode": "system",
    "contrastLevel": 0,
    "motionScheme": "expressive"
  },
  "i18n": { "locale": "zh-CN", "direction": "auto" },
  "css": { "output": "src/styles/m3e-theme.css" }
}
```

```tsx
import "./styles/m3e-theme.css";
import "m3eui/styles.css";
import { M3EProvider, Button, Switch, Slider } from "m3eui";
import m3eConfig from "../m3e.json";

export function RootUI({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <M3EProvider config={m3eConfig}>{children}</M3EProvider>;
}
```

## Complete `m3eui` Component & Hook Exports (60+)
- **Config, i18n, Context & Physics**: `M3EProvider`, `CSPProvider`, `useM3E`, `useM3EI18n`, `defineM3EConfig`, `resolveM3EConfig`, `generateM3EStaticThemeCss`, `getM3EInitScript`, `zhCNMessages`, `enUSMessages`, `jaJPMessages`, `arSAMessages`, `useM3EScalarSpring`, `useM3ECornerSpring`, `usePressHoldState`
- **Actions & Toolbars**: `Button`, `ToggleButton`, `IconButton` (5 sizes × 3 widths), `IconToggleButton`, `SplitButton`, `ButtonGroup` (`standard` 15% zero-sum squish / `connected` 2px seam), `FloatingToolbar`, `FABMenu`, `FAB`, `ExtendedFAB`
- **Form & Inputs**: `Form`, `Fieldset` (`<legend>` first child), `SearchBar` (IME-safe), `OTPField` (connected slot detachment + WebOTP), `TextField`, `TextareaField`, `NumberField`, `Combobox`, `Select` (`outlined` / `filled`), `Switch`, `Slider`, `Checkbox`, `CheckboxGroup`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`
- **Date & Time**: `DockedDatePicker`, `DatePickerField`, `DateRangePicker`, `TimePicker` (12h AM/PM & 24h dual ring + keyboard mode), `TimePickerField`
- **Data Display, Disclosure & Surfaces**: `Collapsible` (`hidden="until-found"`), `Accordion` (`showExpandAll`), `Carousel` (`multi-browse` / `hero` zero-sum layout), `DataTable` (locale-aware `Intl.Collator` sorting + `aria-sort` + selection), `Skeleton` (standard + 35 `MaterialShapes`), `AssistChip`, `FilterChip`, `InputChip`, `Avatar` (35 `MaterialShapes`), `Badge`, `Card`, `SegmentedList`, `SegmentedListItem`, `PreviewCard`, `ScrollArea`, `Divider`
- **Navigation**: `NavigationMenu` (site mega-menu + `aria-current="page"`), `TopAppBar` (`small` / `center-aligned` / `medium-flexible` / `large-flexible`), `NavigationBar`, `NavigationRail`, `WideNavigationRail`, `NavigationDrawer` (`permanent` / `modal`), `NavigationSuite` (adaptive `ResizeObserver`), `Menubar` (single tab stop + nested `submenu`), `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `Tab`, `TabsPanel`
- **Overlays, Feedback & Shapes**: `Sheet`, `BottomSheet`, `SideSheet`, `SheetClose`, `Popover`, `PopoverClose`, `DropdownMenu` (recursive `submenu` & `checked`), `ContextMenu`, `Dialog`, `DialogClose`, `AlertDialog`, `AlertDialogClose`, `Tooltip`, `RichTooltip`, `useM3EToast`, `LinearProgressIndicator`, `CircularProgressIndicator`, `Meter`, `LoadingIndicator`, `ContainedLoadingIndicator`, `WavyProgressIndicator`, `LinearWavyProgressIndicator`, `CircularWavyProgressIndicator`, `MaterialShapeView`

## Mandatory M3E Design & Engineering Invariants
1. **Zero Hardcoded UI Strings**: Every built-in label, placeholder, and status announcement routes through `M3EMessages` keys (`t(key, params)`) and UTC-anchored `Intl.DateTimeFormat` / `Intl.Collator`.
2. **Dual-Track Spring Separation**: Spatial springs (`ζ = 0.6 / 0.8`) drive ONLY geometry; Effects springs (`ζ = 1.0`, zero overshoot) drive ONLY opacity/color/shadow.
3. **Concentric Nested Radii**: Always satisfy $R_{\text{inner}} = \max(0, R_{\text{outer}} - P_{\text{padding}})$.
4. **Searchable Disclosures & Site Nav**: `Collapsible` keeps borders/padding on nested wrappers inside `[hidden="until-found"]`; `NavigationMenu` marks current pages via `aria-current="page"`.
